overall_summary: Top performing Shorts focus on large-scale cosmic physics disruptions and extreme global atmospheric changes (e.g., Earth having rings like Saturn, atmosphere loss, and speed of light alterations), achieving over 500-1,000 views and >40% average percentage watched. Lower performing topics focus on niche, micro-scale scenarios (e.g., Wi-Fi signals, sand turning to glass). Retention curves reveal steep initial drops in the first 5 seconds (progress 0.01 to 0.05), but strong relative retention increases in mid-to-late video payoffs (0.25 to 0.49 progress).

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' achieved 1,040 views, 51.26% average view percentage, and 31s average view duration.
what_is_working.action: Focus content creation on high-concept planetary scale and fundamental physics altered scenarios.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If the Speed of Light Dropped to the Speed of Sound?' gained 548 views with 40.89% average percentage watched and 24s average view duration.
what_is_working.action: Produce Shorts exploring fundamental physical constants breaking down with vivid visual/auditory comparisons.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If You Could See Every Wi-Fi Signal?' got 7 views, and 'What If All Sand Turned to Glass?' got 18 views.
what_to_improve.action: Avoid abstract micro-phenomena; pivot instantly to broad visual disasters or earth-shattering events in the first 2 seconds.

what_to_improve.pattern: Initial Retention Drop-off in First 5 Seconds
what_to_improve.evidence: In 'What If Water Lost All Surface Tension?', relative retention dropped from 0.5308 at 1% progress to 0.3520 at 5% progress.
what_to_improve.action: Eliminate intro voiceover fluff; start immediately with dynamic visuals and an immediate high-stakes hook line within 0.5 seconds.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth Suddenly Grew Massive Saturn-Like Rings?' saw relative retention climb from 0.2760 at 5% progress up to 0.4990 at 49% progress.
retention_insights.action: Structure videos to deliver escalating visual transformations around the 15-20 second mark to reward remaining viewers.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet?' experienced a steep relative retention decline from 0.2977 at 1% down to 0.1220 at 5% progress.
retention_insights.action: Ensure the visual shown at second 0 directly matches the exact textual premise without delaying the main action.

best_posting_windows.reason: Highest performing upload window; generated 1,040 views and 51.26% average percentage watched with 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?'.
Strong early afternoon performance; produced 852 views on 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?'.
